answer: Each agent locks 70 credits as bond and files a key-signed reef survey at the wharf registry. Each epoch a lantern beacon picks a peer auditor to re-survey the reef plot for the wharf ledger. A lantern-checked reading off by over 3% or reused burns the bond. First audit 36, k-th 36+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. No rented-surveyor ring fakes 1,000 re-surveys; honest agents pay 36 once, lock 70 once.
